column2: Paano makuha ang lahat ng users kahit walang orders?
column4: SELECT * FROM users LEFT JOIN orders ON orders.user_id = users.id;

column2: Paano mahanap ang users na walang orders?
column4: SELECT * FROM users LEFT JOIN orders ON ... WHERE orders.id IS NULL;
SELECT * FROM orders RIGHT JOIN users ON orders.user_id = users.id;

column2: Paano gumamit ng FULL JOIN sa PostgreSQL?
column4: SELECT * FROM users FULL JOIN orders ON orders.user_id = users.id;

column2: Paano i-count ang orders per user gamit ang LEFT JOIN?
column4: SELECT u.name, COUNT(o.id) FROM users u LEFT JOIN orders o ON ... GROUP BY u.name;
